## What changes and why?

Describe the concrete problem and the resulting behavior. Link a public issue if relevant.

## Validation

List the checks actually run and their results. Explain any checks that could not run.

## Privacy and compatibility

Describe changes to the protocol, metadata, cache lifetime, dependencies or trust assumptions. Write "None" if there are no changes in these areas.

- [ ] The description, screenshots and fixtures contain only synthetic data; no private links, messages, capabilities, credentials, IP addresses or production logs.
- [ ] Relevant tests, documentation and dependency license notices are updated.
- [ ] Consuming operations still avoid automatic retries after an ambiguous response.
- [ ] Protocol changes, if any, update the version, specification and every client.

For an undisclosed vulnerability, use the private reporting instructions in [SECURITY.md](../SECURITY.md) before opening a public pull request.
